The '''Progate Temple''' was a [[temple]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] used by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
It held the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Karina the Great/Legends|Karina the Great]] and her [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|hive]] of [[Zombie/Legends|undead Geonosians]].<ref name="Legacy" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] fled here after his [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid factory]] was destroyed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].<ref name="Legacy" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]] followed Poggle to the temple, but were attacked by Karina's horde upon arrival. The undead warriors killed Buzz and took Luminara into the [[Geonosian catacombs/Legends|catacombs]] below to Karina. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and a squad of troopers flew to the temple once a sandstorm had passed to find Luminara when they were swarmed by the undead Geonosians as they entered. The temple's supports in the catacombs were shot down by the troopers as the Jedi rescued Luminara and captured Poggle. The Progate Temple caved in seconds after the Jedi, Poggle, and remaining troops escaped, burying Karina.<ref name="Legacy" />
